svg.title: Nacre civil aviation — aircraft, airports, and air traffic control
svg.desc: Ten towered civil airports and eleven representative routes, with separate passenger and cargo markings. Three regional air traffic control centers coordinate Northern, Continental, and Coastal airspace.
